dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: Ah, dear guest. You must've seen how luxurious my perch is and couldn't restrain the curiosity in your heart to inquire about it... Ah, now, this was built at no small expense!

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: I shall not lie. Yonder flight path features the loveliest of routes in this region. I built it with mine own hands.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: The route begins here and then goes through all the most famous spots on this island ere it returns. You are also free to leave any time you wish, should the desire to view anything up close take your fancy!

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: Convenient beyond compare, is it not? ...Ah, you wish to make use of this route? Well then, I shall have to see your Nightwatch Contract, lest our glorious Prinzessin should find fault in mine doings...

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: A most luxurious line, is it not? Well then, produce thine Nightwatch Contract, and it shall be yours to use!

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: Forsooth, this is Her Highness' own writing! You must also be a guest of high standing indeed! Well then! Allow me to grant you passage for this path.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: What say you? Shall you experience the wonders of this island?

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Boss
dialogues.text: Then forward this way, honored guest. Enjoy the lovely sights on this island!
